fusions.name: Rebounding Rim
fusions.desc: Skims your guard off the first enemy it meets for 8 damage, then on to 2 more within 3.5 tiles at 60% of the damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Ring the Rim
fusions.desc: A turning shove with the guard that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocks them back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Practised Parry
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs up to 20 damage for 4 seconds, and raises your armour by 5% while it holds.

fusions.name: Turned Aside
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
